name: io.github.tonyyang0504/gmarket_esm-mcp
description: Gmarket / Auction (ESM) (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped, update_listing, set_inv

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GMARKET_ESM_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ESM Trading API Secret Key issued by Gmarket after the e-mail application (etapihelp@gmail.com); signs the HS256 JWT sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <JWT>' on every call. Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GMARKET_ESM_MASTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your ESM+ master id; sent as the JWT header `kid` (selling-tool vendors put their own master id here). https://etapi.gmarket.com/pages/API-가이드

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GMARKET_ESM_SITE_SELLER_IDS
environmentVariables.description: The JWT `ssi` claim: site id + seller id pairs, e.g. 'A:myauctionid,G:mygmarketid' (A = Auction, G = Gmarket; one of each at most).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GMARKET_ESM_SITE_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Site whose orders list_orders reads: 1 = Auction, 2 = Gmarket (RequestOrders siteType).
